race.comment: Tricky race to see us out. CHANCE TAKEN (6) doesn't win out of turn but has been knocking on the door throughout this prep and the form around him has been stacking up. Strips rock-hard fit and only needs to hold his current condition to be right there at the business end. EAGLELOU (1) is another that is nearing a win and finds a suitable contest. Shoulders a solid record at this venue and doesn't need to improve much to salute this time. CHARTIN (15) is unbeaten over this track and trip from two attempts and gets in well with the 2kg claimer reuniting. Gets a great chance to break a long run of outs. RETOURNE (17) produced a much better effort last start when closing strongly to miss by a head at Strathalbyn. Gets in light and deserves respect. IRLANDAIS (11) also just missed last start and has found form with back-to-back minor placings. In the mix.
